description: This file defines the ComparableRange class, which implements a generic range of comparable values with methods for range comparison, inclusion, and overlap detection.

classes.name: ComparableRange
classes.description: A generic class representing a range of comparable values with methods for range operations and comparisons.

methods.name: getStart
methods.description: Returns the start value of the range.

methods.name: getEnd
methods.description: Returns the end value of the range.

methods.name: ComparableRange
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the range with start and end values, ensuring start is less than or equal to end.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Checks if this range is after another range or value.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Checks if this range is before another range or value.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns the end value of the range.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the range object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this range with another ComparableRange.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Checks if this range includes another range or a specific value.

methods.name: isPoint
methods.description: Indicates if the range is a single point.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if this range overlaps with another range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the start value of the range.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the range.
